concepts.def: Specific brain areas support specific functions; Broca's area (1861) for speech production, Wernicke's for comprehension.
Brain's capacity to reorganise neural pathways in response to experience; Maguire (2000) found enlarged hippocampi in London taxi drivers.
Crockett (2010) showed serotonin manipulation altered prosocial decisions in a moral judgement task.
Newcomer (1999) found cortisol injections impaired declarative memory, supporting stress-memory links.
Caspi (2003) found 5-HTT short allele plus stressful life events predicted depression: gene-environment interaction.
Behaviour shaped by natural selection: Fessler (2006) found pregnancy sickness peaks in first trimester to protect the fetus.
